comparison: Ten matched native editor viewport views before and with the candidate
observations: The lower arched frames follow their openings, with highlights on the shaped glazing bars in both paint colours.
The interior view confirms that the frame and bars remain visible from the reverse side, correcting the original missing faces.
Green and red shed doors show individual timber boards, tapered straps, hinges, fasteners and handles.
Warehouse scuppers, offset pipes and open hoppers visibly clear the cornice; shed hoppers meet the pierced gutters and folded roof aprons.
The lower pipe is hollow and smoothly bent, and its material no longer shows the old repeated horizontal scan-padding streaks.
Both wide views preserve the existing architecture, routes, lighting and backdrop. The recent street grate and paving aperture are intact.
limits: The two performance samples span an editor viewport and a later Spillway play session, so they are invalid as a before/after comparison.
The console's viewport hover exceptions originate in Sandbox.Gizmo.GizmoHitbox.TrySetHovered, not a project compile diagnostic; their effect on timing is unmeasured.
